policy.observation: full viewport image-only, numbered targets, crop clear4096x4096

review.frames: first4 plus last4 unique delivered image hashes, maximum8, chronological
review.transport: new post-exploration review assembled from current run in-memory observed images; no saved request replay

comparison.firstClick: first performed model click label versus first recorded human click label; first action and reason are distinct
comparison.fontIssue: readability category plus cited target whose observed visible label first line equals その他
comparison.organizationIssue: organization category plus cited target whose observed visible label first line equals 各種設定 or その他; only partial conceptual alignment, not evidence of the same expectation
comparison.unsupported: same category without matching target is nonspecific; none/error/missing must not be promoted to agreement
comparison.operationCounts: report clicks, scroll events, back separately; do not compare human6 clicks to aggregate model UI actions

limits: One participant and one new model trial
Post-hoc comparison protocol informed by participant reports; no prospective prediction validity claim
Fixed generic categories elicit review, not spontaneous free-text discovery
Human native unnumbered full viewport versus model numbered full viewport
Participant persona and gaze unmeasured; model uses baseline policy
Human initial source identity not captured at acquisition; independently compare saved initial PNG to fresh unoperated UI
